## What it does

This fixture exists for the source-copy check. Here the fixture skill says that the planted sentence of twelve plain words lives only in this folder, and the check must flag it.

## When to use it

When a destination needs describing.

## Example request

> Map this into a Spec.

## What it requires

Established intent.

## What it does not authorize

Planning or building.

## FAQs

### Is the copied run flagged?

Yes, by the source check self-test.

### Is the text printed?

No, only article, section and offset.

### Does a short shared phrase count?

No, a run under ten words passes.

## It's working when

- The check names this article and section.

## Where it fits in the workflow

First main-flow skill of the Prepare stage.
